about: BO-15's correction detector cases. Each case is a short session (events, in Claude Code's real transcript shapes via tests/transcripts/mod.rs) and what the detector must find: `expect` maps a turn number (every prompt counts, task notifications too) to the exact signals of that turn as 'LAYER kind'; a turn not listed has none. `checks` lists the turns whose prompt carries the C4 line. Every text is made up. A case with `missed` is a correction the detector does not catch yet: `expect` and `checks` are what it finds today, `missed.turn` is the turn that corrects the AI and `missed.why` says how. BO-17's backstop saves such cases from real sessions on the user's machine only; the ones here are made up, modelled on the misses of BO-17's gate 4 (2026-10-02 sessions).
